title: AllergenProfile
description: Probability that an entity carries each allergen unit. Bins: set by orders from the bin label (Laya), and a person can adjust it before saving. Tools, hands, plates: clean at shift start, then updated by the partner graph.

probabilities.description: Allergen unit ID -> probability. Units not listed are 0, unless unknown is true.

unknown.description: True when the entity's history is unknown (appeared mid-shift, re-acquired track). Treated as possibly carrying every allergen (safety rule: known-clean source).

source.description: laya: read from the bin label. manual: set or adjusted by a person. The rest are set by the partner graph.
